thread:
maria: Heads-up: next week we'll be renaming several Okta groups as part of the identity tidy-up. Window: Apr 12 22:00 UTC -> Apr 13 02:00 UTC. This affects GitHub team syncs and service-account group memberships. Please read and react if this impacts you.

julian: quick q  will this break the GitHub org SCIM sync?

maria: SCIM sync remains enabled. We'll update the groupName -> GitHub team mapping in the SCIM app before the rename, then perform a staged rename with aliases. Expect transient mismatch for ~5-10 minutes per group during propagation.

sophia: Which groups are in scope? Can we get a list?

maria: list: eng-frontend -> eng-frontend (rename to frontend-engineering), eng-backend -> backend-engineering, infra-admins -> infra-ops. Full list in the doc: https://redwood-internal/security/okta-group-rename-2026.md

chris: we have CI tokens bound to the infra-admins group for self-hosted runners. Will those tokens be invalidated?

maria: good catch. For service accounts we won't touch group IDs; we'll create an alias group mapping so existing group IDs remain in the token claims. We'll still test that workflow in staging.

okta-admin: bot: staged-rename dry-run completed at 1768005200. No broken SCIM mappings found in staging. Report: https://artifacts.redwood/okta/dryrun-1768005200.csv :white_check_mark:

julian: nice. Can we get the exact GitHub API call you used for validation? Want to replicate locally.

okta-admin: bot: validation snippet:

```
curl -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
  "https://api.github.com/orgs/redwood/teams" | jq '.[] | {name: .name, slug: .slug, members_count: .members_count}'
```

maria: also note: we'll update the SCIM mapping file in the admin repo: https://git.redwood/platform/identity/scim-mappings.yaml (PR opens in 30m). Please add any requested team-name aliases to that PR.

sophia: will SAML assertions change? Some apps use group names in assertions for role mapping.

maria: SAML group attribute will include both primary and alias names during transition. We add alias values to the assertion for 7 days. After that we remove aliases if no consumer needs them.

chris: What about workflows that reference team slugs in repo CODEOWNERS or GitHub Actions? Those are sensitive.

maria: CODEOWNERS references by path should be unaffected. Team slugs may change when we rename; we'll create redirects at the org level where GitHub supports it, and we'll list slug changes so teams can update internal configs. We'll also open a temporary automation PR runner to patch CODEOWNERS across repos for teams that opt-in.

julian: opt-in automation sounds great. How do we sign up?

maria: add a comment on the SCIM PR with repo list and we'll run the patch job. We recommend opting in if you have >5 repos referencing the old slug.

okta-admin: bot: final-run scheduled for 1768006800. Backup snapshot written: s3://redwood-okta-backups/snapshot-1768006700.json

sophia: can we schedule a 30min office hour right before the window? some product teams want to double-check SAML imports.

maria: scheduled: Apr 12 21:00 UTC office hour. Invite sent to impacted teams.

chris: post-rename smoke tests we can run?

maria: yes  checklist in the runbook: 1) verify SCIM team counts, 2) check GitHub org team slugs & redirects, 3) test CI token claims for service accounts, 4) validate SAML group assertions for sample users. Runbook link: https://git.redwood/ops/identity/runbooks/okta-rename.md

julian: thanks. I'll run the team-count check script and paste results here.

okta-admin: bot: reminder: please ensure any manual integrations referencing exact group strings are updated before 1768006500.

maria: thanks everyone. If you hit any blockers, DM me. We'll keep the incident channel #infra-identity for post-cutover rollups. :lock:
